description: 서울교통공사_지하철역사내실내공기질정보(시간단위) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울교통공사. 서울교통공사에서 제공하는 본 정보는 서울교통공사가 관리하는 지하철 역사 내 실내공기질에 대한 데이터입니다. 2021년 기준으로 1호선부터 8호선까지 총 259개 역사에 실내공기질 측정기가. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울교통공사. Its tags are 지하철환경, 공기질, 실내공기질, 환경기계, 지하철역사. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
